CustomField.label: Legacy Tier
CustomField.formula: IF(ISBLANK(Parent.Name), CASE(TEXT(Industry), 'Banking', 'Gold', 'Retail', IF(Legacy_Contact_Count__c > 2, 'Silver', 'Bronze'), IF(AnnualRevenue > 1000000, 'Gold', IF(NumberOfEmployees > 50, 'Silver', IF(LEN(Name) > 20, 'Long Name Tier', 'Bronze')))), 'Child of ' & Parent.Name & IF(ISBLANK(Parent.Parent.Name), '', ' / ' & Parent.Parent.Name))
